verdict.rationale: Trello offers automation and a REST API, so the question of what happens when plan limits are exceeded applies. However, nothing in the pack documents automation run quotas, API rate limits, throttling, overage charges, or hard-stop behavior. The community complaint about 'add on restrictions' concerns Power-Up count limits for solo users, not automation or API overage behavior, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
